partners.title: Partners & profit split
partners.lead: Capital, equity shares, drawings and each partner's share of net profit — calculated automatically.
partners.delete_confirm: Delete {name} and their capital ledger? Past distribution statements are kept. Type the partner's name to confirm.
partners.no_split: Add partners to see the ownership split.
partners.equity_warning_text: Shares should add up to exactly 100% so that all profit is allocated.
partners.how_text: Each partner receives net profit × their equity share. Net payable is what the business owes the partner: capital in, plus profit share, minus money taken out.
partners.formula_payable: Net payable = initial capital + contributions + allocated profit − withdrawals
partners.empty_text: Add each partner with their capital and equity share. Profit allocation is calculated automatically.
partners.initial_help: Capital paid in when joining. Later injections go in the ledger.
partners.initial_help_edit: To record new capital, use "Record contribution / withdrawal" so it appears in the ledger.
partners.allow_overdraw: Allow a withdrawal above the available balance
partners.tx_help: Movements update the partner's totals and are kept in the audit log.
partners.no_movements_text: Contributions and withdrawals you record appear here.
partners.delete_tx_confirm: Delete this movement? The partner's totals are adjusted back.
partners.distribution_lead: Review each partner's share of net profit for a period, record the statement, and optionally pay the shares out.
partners.note_placeholder: e.g. Q3 distribution approved in partners' meeting
partners.payout_help: Paying out records a withdrawal for that partner, dated today, linked to this statement.
partners.record_confirm: Record this distribution statement? Selected payouts will be added to the partners' ledgers.
